name: synthetic_1ycr
description: score_pose_set on make_synthetic_poses() (backend_a and backend_b, seeds 1 to 3, random frames) against the unmoved 1YCR complex, with the 4.5 angstrom epitope and the buried-area interface as residue sets, the crystal peptide as partner and the metrics delta_sasa_static, omega and coulomb.

notes: the structure has no bond table, so hydrocarbon staples and other side-chain cross-links were not looked for
